result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, though the left side is significantly obstructed by trash bins and debris. There is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings, traffic calming measures, or lane markings, creating a vehicle-centric environment despite the residential context.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bins and debris on the left sidewalk force pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or curb ramps are visible, making it difficult for pedestrians to cross safely.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular clearing of trash and debris to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk in front of a stone institutional building. While the walkway is clear of obstructions, there is no physical buffer or vertical separation between pedestrians and the adjacent roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians are directly adjacent to the roadway with only a curb for separation, lacking protection from potential vehicle incursions.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line at the bottom of the image

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters along the curb to provide a vertical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Designate a portion of the wide sidewalk as a furniture zone for benches or bike racks to create a more protected walking path.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks and a signalized intersection with marked crosswalks. However, the environment lacks traffic calming and has visual obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the intersection may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left curb approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles located within the sidewalk area on the right side reduce the effective walking width.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a mid-block urban environment with a paved sidewalk adjacent to a multi-story building with a dark, relatively blank facade. A silver SUV is parked along the curb, and mature trees provide some canopy cover, though the sidewalk surface appears somewhat uneven in the foreground.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface shows cracking and uneven sections which could be a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the sidewalk area

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large, dark, windowless wall at street level reduces natural surveillance and can make the environment feel less safe.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level walking surface and eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety at night.

interventions.title: Active Frontage
interventions.description: Encourage the addition of windows or artistic elements to the blank wall to improve the pedestrian experience and natural surveillance.
